name: Cherry Irene Live Resin All-in-One | 1g
description: Cherry Irene is a strain created by crossing Irene OG x Unknown Cherry Phenotype. This strain features dominant terpenes—ẞ-Caryophyllene: 3.495%, ẞ-Myrcene: 2.868% and a-Humulene: 1.177%—delivering a bold, terpene-rich flavor profile layered with notes of Cinnamon, Orange, Hops, Magnolia, Pine and Chamomile. Crafted with proprietary zero heat solvent removal process, this formulation is 100% Live Resin. This All-in-One device is built for a smooth, full-bodied live resin experience: flavor-forward, satisfying, and consistent from the first pull to the last. Designed for real-life convenience, it’s pre-charged and ready to use, making it an easy go-to for elevated, on-the-go sessions. Enjoy the notes of with Dabstract’s Live Resin All-in-One Device.
